title: Even common-coefficient braid for the two pullbacks
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes, $L\in D_A(Y)$ with canonical self-symmetry $\sigma_{L,L}=1$, $B\in D_A(X)$, $e:B\simeq f^*L$, and $K\in D_A(Y)$. Use the ordinary unbounded derived tensor and canonical coordinate comparisons of [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus], with the canonical signed symmetry of [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. Put $W=X\times_YX$, $U=f^*$, $R=p_1^*$, $V=p_2^*$, $Q=UK$ and $M=B\otimes Q$. Write $\delta_R$, $\delta_V$, $\delta_U$ for the canonical inverse-image tensor isomorphisms, and $\theta:VU\simeq RU$ for the canonical square comparison. Define $d:RM\simeq RB\otimes VQ$ as $\delta_R(B,Q)$ followed by $1_{RB}\otimes\theta_K^{-1}$; this is coefficientSplit. Define $z:(RB\otimes VQ)\otimes VB\simeq VM\otimes RB$ as the associator, $1\otimes\sigma_{VQ,VB}$, $1\otimes\delta_V(B,Q)^{-1}$, then $\sigma_{RB,VM}$; this is cyclicShuffle. Set $c_B=R(e);\theta_L^{-1};V(e^{-1})$, the canonical coordinate comparison on $B$. Set $e_K=(e\otimes1_Q);\delta_U(L,K)^{-1}$ and $c_M=R(e_K);\theta_{L\otimes K}^{-1};V(e_K^{-1})$, the canonical coordinateTwisted comparison on $M$. The generic inverse-image constructions coefficientCoordinate and tensorCoordinate specialize to exactly these maps. Then
$$ (d\otimes1_{VB});z=(c_M\otimes1_{VB});(1_{VM}\otimes c_B^{-1}). $$
No direct image, projection formula, scalar trace, diagonal class, properness, nonzero coefficient, or invertibility of $L$ is assumed.

source.place: Second triangle: common-coefficient extraction and interchange of the two copies of the even coefficient, before the scalar trace.

proof.text: Apply coordinateTensor from lem-sf-supported-coordinate-tensor. This gives cM followed by the V tensor comparison as the R tensor comparison followed by cB tensor the common-base comparison on K. The reversed square comparison is inverse to the original one: expand both through their common composite and use proof irrelevance.

Braidedness of f* transports identity self-braiding of L to f*L. Naturality with e transports it to B; braidedness of p2* transports it to VB. Cancellation of the invertible tensor comparisons proves these equalities also for zero objects.

Expand d and z. Postcompose both sides with id_VM tensor cB and delta_V(B,Q) tensor id_VB, an isomorphism. Naturality moves the V tensor comparison through the final braiding and cancels it. Naturality moves cB through the remaining braiding and associator. The hexagon expands the resulting braid into the self-braiding of VB, which is identity, and two opposite braidings with VQ, which cancel by symmetry. What remains is the equation from the first step tensored with VB. Cancel the postcomposition.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientBraid {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (hL : (((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).app L).app L).hom = 𝟙 _)
    {B : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))}
    (e : B ≅ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj L)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).mapIso
        (coefficientSplit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f B K)).app
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj B) ≪≫
        cyclicShuffle (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj B) B
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K) =
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).mapIso
        (tensorCoordinate (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f L K e)).app
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj B) ≪≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
            (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj
              ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)))).mapIso
                (coefficientCoordinate (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f L e).symm
